coverage: new Gateway UID and generation are observed without stale-baseline refusal
an ongoing rollout returns deployment metadata without running a Pod child
fixed sparse list parsing rejects duplicates and malformed or oversized input
Secret and mixed projected-Secret mounts hide names and keys and skip covered file reads
read-only command allowlist rejects Secret API reads and all mutations
configuration YAML parse errors retain bytes and hash with unknown budget values
successful configuration reads are independently checked again
ancestor symlink and exhausted content-read budget are refused before open
wrong-host execution does not load child resources or issue commands

acceptance_boundary: Read-only current deployment metadata and at most one owned, ready, current-template Pod. This does not authorize a new deployment, verify all Gateway Pods, or establish business acceptance.
